comment: The silk texture is mesmerizing! Pure authentic zari and the drape feels so regal. Received countless compliments at my cousin's wedding.
Stunning temple border craftsmanship. Color matches exactly with the photographs. Prompt packaging too!
Heavy pallu with gorgeous peacock motifs. Beautiful saree overall, arrived in 3 days.
Truly heirloom quality. Eternal Vastra has become my go-to luxury boutique for traditional sarees.
